name: Monport UV Pro 10W
tagline: UV galvo for 3D crystal engraving: 10W, 15,000 mm/s and water chiller included
tldr: The UV Pro 10W is the faster tier of Monport's 3D inner-engraving UV galvo, listed in September 2026: 355 nm, 15,000 mm/s, 30–200 kHz, the same 70 × 70 mm 3D lens (Monport lists a 150 × 150 mm processing area), an electric Z lift and a water chiller in the package. $4,990 on Monport's store in October 2026, on pre-order with shipping in early November. Manual focus, no camera; no independent review yet.

faq.question: Is the UV Pro 10W available now?
faq.answer: Not yet: in October 2026 Monport listed it at $4,990 ($5,190 with LightBurn) with shipping in early November. The 6W tier was available immediately.

faq.question: What does the 10W add over the 6W?
faq.answer: Speed and headroom: 15,000 mm/s against 10,000 mm/s, a 30–200 kHz frequency range against 10–150 kHz, and more power for dense point clouds in 3D crystals and faster marking. Field, lens, software and accessories are the same. The 10W weighs 21.5 kg against 16.5 kg.

faq.question: Can the UV Pro replace a fiber laser?
faq.answer: No. UV marks glass, crystal, plastics and many coatings cleanly and can mark metal surfaces, but it does not engrave metal deeply. For deep metal work, look at a fiber laser such as Monport's GPro Vision.

standoutFeatures.title: 15,000 mm/s galvo
standoutFeatures.body: The fastest scanning speed of the UV Pro line, which shortens dense 3D crystal jobs and batch marking.

standoutFeatures.title: Complete 3D package
standoutFeatures.body: Chiller, 70 × 70 mm 3D lens, electric Z lift, foot pedal and a K9 crystal block come in the box; only LightBurn is extra.

beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W tier of the UV Pro. Pick it if 3D crystals or UV marking are a daily production job; for occasional gifts, compare the entry tier via the chips.
proTips: Batch crystals with the positioning bars to keep placement repeatable. Keep the chiller and room temperature stable during long 3D jobs. Buy K9 blocks from a reliable supplier: inclusions and bubbles show up in the engraving.

editorialDepth.advantages: The 10W tier makes sense for shops whose revenue depends on 3D crystals or UV marking volume: faster scanning and a complete package with chiller and 3D lens.
editorialDepth.limitations: It is a pre-order until November 2026, has manual focus and no camera, and needs strict eye protection around the open UV beam. SapphireMark is Windows-only and no independent review exists yet.
